description:
A guy called 'Kyungsung pistol', Josun Dynasty's best gunman fights for independence for his country. Meanwhile, a devil councilor who wants to destroy 'Kyungsung pistol' Yoshikawa, kidnapped a girl 'Dongyi' who was taking care by 'Kyungsung pistol' and 'Kyungsung pistol' went on a Journey to take her back and complete independence for Josun (Korea).

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/52608861), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H035925968), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H035925968), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=sust), MeToon
